rules.card_order: name, then price (including the currency code), then stock
rules.missing_price: when price is null the card shows the price_unavailable_label
rules.list_items: every item, sorted by name, case-insensitive
rules.search_items: case-insensitive substring match over name and description; results are sorted by name, case-insensitive, for every query; an empty query returns every item
